name: Protected Throw (Combat)
body:
You fend off foes with one hand while making a thrown attack with the other.

Prerequisite(s): Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus with a thrown weapon

Benefit(s): While wielding two weapons, if one of them has a range increment, you may make a thrown weapon attack with that weapon without provoking attacks of opportunity from creatures you threaten. This includes alchemical splash and grenade-like weapons.
